clock: document_date — supersession folds on document dates (the default; set `change.clock = "narrative"` for order within a work)
identity: organization → registry_id (external key, strict merge)
identity: person → name + employer (descriptive keys, judged merge)
identity: counterparty → canonical name (default; declare `identity = [...]` for an external key)
question shapes: enumerate [organization, person, counterparty]; relations [(none)]; events [payment]; aggregate [(none — a claim type with a `ref` attribute can be counted by it)]
